player_prompt.intro:
Ove iwe Mwimbangi {player_id} muna {num_rounds}-tunda ya IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Kila tunda, kamba ombi kati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Ovakwata ombi zote mbali, ombi ove iwe (2/3)x(katengo kwa ombi zote mbali),
na Mwimbangi ove ombi iwe perto kwa ombi ove iwe ovuunda tunda.
Yamba na ombi yeno muna mfano '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ocinimbu eci ka ca sungulukile. Pole, o sukila oku ci soneha ndoco: [<number>] .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kulunga ina kwela kalaashiwa kuwa ni kati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Omutu wa nthala 0 adivinia {guess0}; omutu wa nthala 1 adivinia {guess1}. Ngenyi, Othikilo ni: {target}.
message.round_draw: Oku imba ombunje ca soka ndoku yekela.
